# Recorded experimental evidence — do not edit the originals

- `memoryguard_outputs.tar(2).gz`: full original 100-trial batch, SHA-256 `b94f1eb5e19d7eff0e4527881ef69d47e39b0ebbe15da0937f055df03823cb01`.
- `mg_phase2_results.tar.gz`: four local file-cache reclaim trials (two protected/two unprotected).
- `mg_phase3_results.tar.gz`: four integrated pilot trials (32 alerts).
- `mg_phase4_results.tar.gz`: 32 repeated integrated trials, SHA-256 `8e1b7a3fbb754e872bf35f469999f8eac652699a2c738c5062c2ba8e55ba6bba`.
- `MemoryGuard_Results_Audit_v1.zip`: independently computed baseline checks.
- `MemoryGuard_Phase4_IndependentAudit_v1.zip`: independent Phase 4 recalculation, tables, figures, provenance and original raw archive.

Full raw datasets are separate in the shared Drive folder's evidence subdirectory, so the GitHub code ZIP remains small and reviewable. The 100-trial and 32-trial monitors are not identical experimental treatments.
